commands: P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; test -d "$P/.git"; O=$(git -C "$P" remote get-url origin); printf 'ORIGIN=%s\n' "$O"; case "$O" in https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller|https://github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|git@github.com:MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git|ssh://git@github.com/MichalMatu/growbox-ml-controller.git) ;; *) echo BOUND_REPO_MISMATCH; exit 42;; esac; git -C "$P" fetch -q --prune origin

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; printf '%s
' '=== CHECKOUT ==='; git -C "$P" status --short --branch; printf '%s
' '=== WORKTREES ==='; git -C "$P" worktree list --porcelain; printf '%s
' '=== MAIN ==='; printf 'LOCAL_MAIN='; git -C "$P" rev-parse main; printf 'ORIGIN_MAIN='; git -C "$P" rev-parse origin/main; printf 'MAIN_AHEAD_BEHIND='; git -C "$P" rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; printf '%s\n' '=== LOCAL BRANCHES ==='; git -C "$P" for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)|%(committerdate:iso8601)|%(upstream:short)|%(subject)' refs/heads

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; printf '%s\n' '=== LOCAL CLASSIFICATION VS ORIGIN/MAIN ==='; while IFS= read -r b; do test "$b" = main && continue; if git -C "$P" merge-base --is-ancestor "$b" origin/main 2>/dev/null; then m=MERGED; else m=UNMERGED; fi; ab=$(git -C "$P" rev-list --left-right --count "$b"...origin/main | tr '\t' '/'); printf '%s|%s|ahead/behind=%s\n' "$b" "$m" "$ab"; done < <(git -C "$P" for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/heads | sort)

P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; printf '%s
' '=== REMOTE BRANCHES ==='; git -C "$P" for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)|%(committerdate:iso8601)|%(subject)' refs/remotes/origin | grep -v '^origin/HEAD|' ; printf '%s
' '=== REMOTE CLASSIFICATION VS ORIGIN/MAIN ==='; while IFS= read -r r; do case "$r" in origin/HEAD|origin/main|origin/agent-control) continue;; esac; if git -C "$P" merge-base --is-ancestor "$r" origin/main 2>/dev/null; then m=MERGED; else m=UNMERGED; fi; ab=$(git -C "$P" rev-list --left-right --count "$r"...origin/main | tr '	' '/'); printf '%s|%s|ahead/behind=%s
' "$r" "$m" "$ab"; done < <(git -C "$P" for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' refs/remotes/origin | sort)
